body.name: alternating-block genuinely adaptive finite-population witness
body.construction: For \(G\in4\mathbb N\), represent the four sign pairs \((H_g,J_g)\in\{-1,1\}^2\) equally often and set \(\lambda=1\). On type A blocks take \((a_{Dg},a_{Sg})=(H_g,J_g)\) and \(L=0\); on type B blocks take \((a_{Dg},a_{Sg})=(J_g,H_g)\) and \(L=4\). Set \(\theta_g=4a_{Dg}\), \(\delta_g=L-\theta_g\), \(h_g=a_{Sg}/2+a_{Dg}-L/2\), and \(Y_{gbi}(d,q)=h_g+d(\delta_g+\theta_gq)\).
